verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents that when an invoice payment fails, Stripe can automatically retry the payment and send reminders, so automatic retries of failed payments are a first-party capability. The evidence does not describe how the retry cadence is set (ML-optimized or configurable schedule), and it gives no recovery metrics. Missing for 10: ML/smart or configurable retry-schedule documentation, recurring-renewal context, measurable churn-recovery reporting, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn

citations.quote: If the invoice becomes overdue, or payment on the invoice fails, Stripe can automatically send reminders or retry the payment for you.
